description: This file defines an abstract class 'WriterPart' for the PHPSpreadsheet library, encapsulating common functionality for parts of an XLSX writer, including managing a parent Xlsx object.

classes.name: WriterPart
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for components of the XLSX writer, providing methods to get and set the parent Xlsx object.

methods.name: getParentWriter
methods.description: Returns the parent Xlsx writer object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WriterPart with a parent Xlsx object.
